about: Successor rules for the 18 split rows of supersede-map.json. A material lot's tombstone names one successor, its electrode spec. A spec that covered two designs is split into one spec per design, and its tombstone lists both in replaced_by_iris (owner ruling 2026-10-07); replaced_by_iri, the primary, is only an ordering for clients that read one successor.

default_rule.material: A v1 'material lot' was a coated electrode batch. Its single successor is the electrode spec its v5 discs instance (the batch as a unit), not one of the discs. Default of decision 10 in the close-out plan.
default_rule.cell_spec: A v1 cell spec that covered two electrode designs lists both v5 cell specs. The primary is the one whose working electrode batch label sorts first (natural sort: AQ before NMP, lower batch number first).
default_rule.material_spec: A v1 material spec that covered two electrode designs lists both v5 electrode specs, primary chosen by the same sort.

overrides_help: Map a published_id of a split row to a different successor IRI. For a material lot it replaces the single successor (it must be one of the row's successors or the electrode spec of its discs). For a split spec it only changes which listed successor is the primary. Preflight refuses anything else.
extra_supersedes_help: Rows outside supersede-map.json, as {"published_id", "resource_type", "successor"}.
